project.one_liner: Privacy-first lending broker on Solana with secure note-based flows.
p0_goals: End-to-end SECURE flow on localnet: secure supply → borrow → repay → withdraw, producing updated note strings
On-chain verification of ZK proofs (not demo-only) for SECURE instructions
LTV (70%) enforced on-chain with boundary tests and deterministic reproduction
constraints: LTV fixed at 70% for initial implementation
Evidence gate: acceptance tests may only be marked passing with evidence in progress/Progress.txt
Controlled parallelism with allowed_paths per task

decisions_needed.title: Hash function alignment for Merkle commitments
decisions_needed.question: Should the SECURE flow use Poseidon or SHA-256 for commitments and Merkle hashing across circuits + on-chain program?

options.A: Poseidon everywhere (circuits + on-chain), update on-chain hashing accordingly
options.B: SHA-256 everywhere, update circuits to SHA-256 Merkle
options.C: Hybrid (Poseidon in circuit, SHA-256 on-chain) — NOT recommended due to mismatch risk

decisions_needed.title: Proof system + verifier interface
decisions_needed.question: Which proof system/verifier shape do we standardize on for SECURE instructions?

options.A: Groth16 (snarkjs) with on-chain verifier + strict artifact versioning
options.B: Plonk / other (only if existing infra already chosen)
options.C: Temporary stub verifier for UI-only demo (explicitly non-secure)

decisions_needed.title: Note string schema (versioning + minimal fields)
decisions_needed.question: What fields are required in the note string, and how do we guarantee forward-compatibility?

options.A: veil-note-v1 with explicit payload fields + checksum; version bump on any change
options.B: JSON note (easier debug, larger, more leak-prone)

slices.title: Harness hardening + Clarify Gate enforcement
slices.goal: Stop failing for harness reasons; make failures actionable.

slices.title: Note string encode/decode + deterministic commitment functions
slices.goal: Make note contract explicit and stable before proof wiring.

slices.title: Proof generation pipeline + artifact handling
slices.goal: Generate proofs deterministically in dev environment; cache by inputs.

slices.title: On-chain verification for ONE SECURE instruction
slices.goal: Verify proofs on-chain for secure supply (narrow slice).

slices.title: Full SECURE loop + parity tests
slices.goal: Secure supply/borrow/repay/withdraw + parity checks vs FAST.

assumptions: The repo keeps FAST mode for baseline debugging; SECURE mode is the target.
Proof generation is intended to run in-browser or locally for dev; production proving infrastructure is out-of-scope for this phase.
Compute budget constraints will require explicit handling for SECURE instructions.
